nodes.description: Ownable private owner address; root of the access-control privilege chain.
ERC20 mapping(address=>uint256) of token balances.
ERC20 nested mapping of spender allowances.
ERC20 total supply counter.
DONKEYKONG mapping(address=>bool) whitelist that gates transfers toward _uni.
DONKEYKONG owner-controlled restricted destination address.
Returns msg.sender; the only caller-identity source in the codebase.
View returning _owner.
Modifier requiring owner() == _msgSender() before executing the body.
Internal balance transfer that invokes the virtual _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
Internal mint increasing _totalSupply and _balances.
Empty virtual hook in the base ERC20 implementation.
Public transfer entry point delegating to _transfer with _msgSender().
Public transferFrom entry point that reads and updates allowances.
Deploys token metadata, mints the whole supply to the deployer and whitelists it.
ERC20._mint override enforcing a hard 1e12*1e18 supply cap.
Owner-only function that flips arbitrary _enable whitelist flags.
Owner-only function that overwrites the _uni gating address.
Hook override that requires _enable[from] when the recipient equals _uni.
Caller-controlled address read via _msgSender and used for identity/authorization.
require(_enable[from]) check that can silently block any transfer to _uni.
Unbounded owner write of _enable[user] enabling/disabling arbitrary accounts.
Owner assignment of the _uni address that activates the transfer gate.
Arithmetic comparison of totalSupply()+amount against the fixed supply cap.
Amount parameter of DONKEYKONG._mint used in the cap check.
Address parameter of DONKEYKONG.transfer used as the whitelist key.
Boolean parameter of DONKEYKONG.transfer used as the whitelist value.
Sender parameter of DONKEYKONG._beforeTokenTransfer indexed into _enable.
Recipient parameter of DONKEYKONG._beforeTokenTransfer compared to _uni.
Address parameter of DONKEYKONG.RenounceOwnership assigned to _uni.
Local cache of _balances[sender] inside ERC20._transfer.
Local cache of _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] inside ERC20.transferFrom.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned verbatim by Context._msgSender, carrying caller identity into the contract.
_msgSender() result is compared with owner() in the onlyOwner modifier guard.
onlyOwner invokes owner() to validate the caller privilege before running the body.
owner() reads the _owner state variable and returns it.
onlyOwner gates DONKEYKONG.transfer, restricting whitelist mutation to the owner.
onlyOwner gates DONKEYKONG.RenounceOwnership, restricting _uni reconfiguration to the owner.
DONKEYKONG.transfer writes the arbitrary user key into the _enable whitelist mapping.
The owner-only flag write is the unsafe operation that controls who can receive tokens at _uni.
RenounceOwnership stores the caller-supplied uni_ address into the _uni state variable.
The owner-only assignment is the unsafe operation that arms the gating address.
_uni is compared against the `to` argument inside the DONKEYKONG._beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_enable[from] is read inside the hook to decide whether the transfer is allowed.
The hook executes require(_enable[from]), an unsafe gate that can freeze transfers to _uni.
The gate condition reads back the owner-mutable _enable whitelist state.
totalSupply() + amount is evaluated against the 1e12*1e18 cap before minting.
The override delegates the actual state mutation to super._mint after the cap check.
_transfer calls the virtual _beforeTokenTransfer hook, dynamically dispatching to the DONKEYKONG override.
DONKEYKONG._beforeTokenTransfer overrides the base ERC20 hook implementation.
_transfer debits and credits entries of the _balances mapping.
_mint increases the _totalSupply counter.
ERC20.transfer delegates to the internal _transfer implementation.
ERC20.transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer implementation.
ERC20.transfer passes _msgSender() as the sender argument of _transfer.
transferFrom reads and decreases the _allowances entry for sender and caller.
The DONKEYKONG constructor mints the initial supply through the overridden _mint.
The constructor pre-whitelists the deployer address in _enable.
The amount parameter feeds the arithmetic cap comparison inside _mint.
The user parameter is used as the key of the _enable whitelist write.
The enable parameter is used as the value of the _enable whitelist write.
The from parameter is indexed into _enable inside the gating hook.
The to parameter is compared against _uni inside the gating hook.
The uni_ parameter is assigned to the _uni state variable.
senderBalance caches _balances[sender] during the transfer.
currentAllowance caches the caller allowance during transferFrom.
The owner-only flag write mutates the _enable whitelist state that gates transfers.
The owner-only assignment mutates the _uni gating destination state.

normalization_plan.reason: The `amount` parameter of DONKEYKONG._mint is only meaningful inside the cap-check of the same function, so it folds into that core function.
The `user` parameter of DONKEYKONG.transfer is a pure binding for the _enable write inside that core function.
The `enable` parameter of DONKEYKONG.transfer is a pure binding for the _enable write inside that core function.
The `from` parameter of DONKEYKONG._beforeTokenTransfer exists only as the lookup key used by the gating hook.
The `to` parameter of DONKEYKONG._beforeTokenTransfer exists only for the comparison against _uni in the gating hook.
The `uni_` parameter of DONKEYKONG.RenounceOwnership is immediately stored into _uni by that core function.
The `senderBalance` local variable is a transient cache used only within ERC20._transfer.
The `currentAllowance` local variable is a transient cache used only within ERC20.transferFrom.
